name: Health
description: Daily steps sent from your phone, shown as a mirror. It never enters your scores and never ticks anything for you.
heading: Your
lede: The step count your phone sends each day. It is a mirror next to your activities: it never enters your scores and never ticks anything for you.
empty: No steps yet. Connect your phone below and the days will appear here.
connectHint: Your phone sends the numbers to this app with a token that can only write steps: it cannot read anything. Revoke it whenever you want.
shownOnce: Copy this token now: it is shown only once.
tooMany: Too many active tokens. Revoke one first.
howTo: Send a POST with the header Authorization: Bearer <token> and the body {"steps": 8400}, or connect an app that exports Apple Health. Details are in docs/health.md.
foot: A day keeps the highest count received. A day without data stays empty.
